plan.notes: Independent synthetic sensitivity grid, not calibrated to any publisher. All eligible users including zero-outcome users enter roster reference. Constant proportional potential-outcome effects. Monte Carlo CI units are trials. HT comparisons are fixed-final-estimator tests with point>=1% and unique-roster SRM; daily guardrails are not replayed in this grid. Holdout reference gets full roster; current feed selection defect is tested by separate deterministic witnesses. CUPED slope is estimated once on an independent 100000-user historical sample. Results across effect sizes reuse common random numbers and are correlated. Confidence bounds use asymptotic theory; no claim of finite-sample universal validity.

sequential.model: Gaussian independent daily increments; isolates repeated looks only; no guardrails/minimum effect

auctions.assumptions: 3 bidders, lognormal private values; no budgets, no learning, no app retention; response model imposed, not fitted
